records.text: And let me tell you, this was one of the hardest things for me to go through. I mean, I love, love Ye (Kanye West), love him now, but, like, it was just—it was untrue, and it allowed people to then—I mean, every single article: "Candace lied," you know? And I actually have a photo of me with Kanye (Kanye West) at the Trump Hotel in Chicago, and I didn't know what was happening. And I, you know, at the time called a friend, and they were like, "You don't know what he's going through and what's—"
records.speaker: Candace Owens
